# Free Remote MCP Servers

11,903 public MCP server URLs answered without a key in our test. Pick one, paste it into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code, done.

11,903 of 20,778 remote MCP servers in the official MCP Registry (57 %) answered without any API key, token or login when we tested them on 2026-10-26. After removing copies and mass-generated entries, 9,631 remain. Below are 300 picks by topic; the full list is a free download.

Download all 9,631 as CSV JSON GitHub (re-tested weekly)

## How we tested

The official MCP Registry listed 33,658 remote endpoints. We kept Streamable HTTP endpoints that require no headers, skipped temporary tunnels and tested at most five URLs per host, which left 20,778. Each got exactly two requests without credentials, `initialize` and `tools/list`; no tool was ever called. 11,903 answered with a tool list, 6,529 asked for authentication (OAuth or a key) and 2,346 did not answer correctly within 10 seconds.

Many open servers are copies of the same template on hundreds of subdomains. We dropped entries whose tool set appears more than three times or whose description appears more than twice, and kept at most two per domain. The picks below prefer servers with a website or repository, 3 to 40 tools and fast responses, one per publisher. Open means usable without signing up, not free forever, and listing is not an endorsement: read what a server does before you connect it, especially if it can write or spend.

## Add a server

Claude: Customize, Connectors, + Add, Add custom connector, paste the URL. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http NAME URL`. Cursor: `{ "mcpServers": { "NAME": { "url": "URL" } } }`. VS Code: `{ "servers": { "NAME": { "type": "http", "url": "URL" } } }`. Not sure a server still works? Use our MCP Server Tester, every row has a «test it» link.

## Picks by topic

Search and web · Documentation and knowledge · Developer tools · Weather, maps and travel · Media and content · Finance and crypto · Science, health and research · Open data and government · Business and marketing · AI, agents and memory · Utilities · Other

## How it works

  1. Pick a server Browse the topics or download the full list.
  2. Add it as a connector Claude: Customize, Connectors, + Add, Add custom connector. Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code: see above.
  3. Ask in plain words Your assistant lists the server's tools and calls them when they fit.

## FAQ

Are there free remote MCP servers?

Yes. In our test of 20,778 endpoints from the official MCP Registry, 11,903 answered without any API key or login. Picks by topic are on this page, the full list is a CSV download.

What is a remote MCP server?

An MCP server that runs on someone else's machine and is reached over HTTPS, so you add a URL instead of installing anything. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code support them.

Which public MCP server can I use for testing?

Pick a read-only one from Documentation and knowledge or Weather, maps and travel: they need no input from you and cannot change anything. Check it first with our MCP Server Tester.

How many MCP servers need authentication?

6,529 of the 20,778 endpoints we tested (31 %) answered with 401 or 403 or asked for a token, usually OAuth handled by your client.

How often is the list updated?

This version is from 2026-10-26. We rerun the probe regularly; servers that stop answering drop out.
